content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates already employed at the Institute / IRD cannot be interviewed unless their application is forwarded by their establishment/section.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: PhD in Biotechnology with experience in molecular biology, protein purification, recombinant protein production. Pay: Rs.58,000 p.m. plus HRA @30%. Qualification required: Graduate in any discipline with 5 years experience in a molecular biology or microbiology lab. Experience required: 5 years experience in a molecular biology or microbiology lab. Pay: Rs.20,000 p.m. plus HRA @30%. Qualification required: 1st class M.Tech in Life Sciences/Biochemistry/Biochemical Engineering/Biotechnology with GATE/NET qualification. Pay: Rs.37,000 p.m. plus HRA @30%.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is contractual on consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the project duration, whichever is earlier. Project duration is up to 13-05-2028.

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT Delhi Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in test / interview 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. Salary of a retired/superannuated government employee will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. NET/GATE requirement for JRF may be relaxed for graduates of CFTIs with CGPA above 8.000 (80% aggregate marks).

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Formal application on Form No. IRD/REC-4 Recent passport size photograph Original academic and professional certificates for verification Details of work experience

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec). Fill the form with complete details of educational qualifications, percentage of marks of each examination passed and work experience. Bring the form with a recent passport size photograph and original academic and professional certificates for verification on the interview date. Appear at the walk-in venue on 18-11-2026 at the time given for your post.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Project: Sustainable valorization of low cost substrates into high value porous carbon for carbon capture (RM00197G_SN), funded by Department of Biotechnology. Eligibility queries can be sent to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Research Associate, 1 Project Assistant (Admin.), 1 Jr. Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 18 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Committee Room of DBEB, IIT Delhi, Hauz Khas, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.58,000 p.m. plus HRA @30% for Research Associate, Rs.20,000 p.m. plus HRA @30% for Project Assistant (Admin.), Rs.37,000 p.m. plus HRA @30% for Jr. Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Research Associate: PhD in Biotechnology with experience in molecular biology, protein purification, recombinant protein production. Project Assistant (Admin): Graduate in any discipline with 5 years experience in a molecular biology or microbiology lab. JRF: 1st class M.Tech in Life Sciences/Biochemistry/Biochemical Engineering/Biotechnology with GATE/NET. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be of Indian nationality.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates already employed at the Institute / IRD cannot be interviewed unless their application is forwarded by their establishment/section.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in test / interview. 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. Salary of a retired/superannuated government employee will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. NET/GATE requirement for JRF may be relaxed for graduates of CFTIs with CGPA above 8.000 (80% aggregate marks).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is contractual on consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the project duration, whichever is earlier. Project duration is up to 13-05-2028.
